title: Momoi Airi — Cooking Stream Prep〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we have all the ingredients we need for this recipe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today, I'll be testing out the recipes I've picked out for my stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My stomach's already grumbling!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, hold your horses.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is meant to be a full dress rehearsal, so let me know if something doesn't seem right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, the three recipes I have as candidates are... A rice bowl with three toppings, chopped daikon radish leaves with fried tofu and tuna butter rice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll need you two to help me make them, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We promise to do our best so that they turn out really yummy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. Then, let's get started, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So, the toppings for the rice bowl are...
Ground chicken, scrambled eggs and stir-fried bell peppers, yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ground chicken and eggs go great together. And bell peppers are really good for you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Doesn't that make this a nutritionally complete meal?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That might be saying too much.
But there's no doubting that it's nutritious and delicious.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but... Not everybody likes bell peppers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've got that covered.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For those who aren't fans of bell peppers, I've come up with an alternative recipe that replaces them with snow peas and spinach.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I plan to demonstrate those as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa!
That's amazing, Airi! You really do have all your bases covered...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next is the chopped radish leaves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's common for people to toss the leaves, so it should be nice to present a recipe that makes use of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Not only are they really nutritious, they're actually really versatile.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, they are a bit bitter, but that can be remedied by cooking them. I even threw in some sakura shrimp for a better aroma.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, this would go amazingly well with rice!
I can't wait to try it...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And for the tuna butter rice, you're going to drain all the oil from the tuna can, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. But that's just my preference. Those who want a bolder flavor can leave the oil.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I bought some extra tuna, so why don't we give that a try too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! We get to compare them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There we are!
We managed to make everything I had planned.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Each dish went very smoothly, so I feel that our stream will go very well if we present everything at this pace.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Also, everything looks so good...!
The smell alone is making my mouth water!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm also starting to get a little hungry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, let's start seeing how everything tastes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Put your hands together, and... Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These radish leaves are delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And they go perfectly with rice... Nom...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
So, Minori, how's the tuna rice?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, we won't know what you're thinking if you don't tell us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's weird...
I thought I just said how yummy and delicious this dish is over and over.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, in your head.
Also, you gotta say more than “yummy” and “delicious”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...! I still have a lot to learn...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That being said, I'm glad to hear that it tastes good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And we finished cooking right on time.
This means we should be able to make everything live just fine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we also have those alternative recipes to consider... Why don't we talk about how we're gonna work those in?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Good morning!
We're back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We're... Wait, huh?
Something smells really good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you're both back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We were just whipping up some yummy dishes for an upcoming stream!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, I see!
That explains this delicious aroma...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you're hungry, then wanna join us for our taste test? Everything's done, so I'd love to hear what you both think.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, I am pretty hungry... So, Airi, if you don't mind us having some of your cooking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, gimme a sec to get you two some rice. You're in for a treat since these dishes turned out really well!
